text:
Ryan (Product): Quick sync — thinking we should change metering for high-frequency embeddings and offer a separate "Priority Route" add-on. Current token tiers don't map well to batch/real-time workloads. Thoughts?

Jonah (Sales): +1. Sales sees customers asking for consistent p99 latency guarantees. They'll pay for priority, but need predictable bill. Can we price by reserved qps instead of pure token rate?

Tess (Finance): We can do reserved-QPS + per-token overlay, but need a minimum ARR floor for SLA. Also want an auto-grandfather rule for contracts signed before the change.

Amy (Legal): Agree on grandfathering. Also need to update T&Cs for priority routing -- we can't promise cross-region failover for private deployments without explicit clause.

Sana (Customer Success): Migration pain is real. Request a one-time migration credit and a script to remap legacy usage. Also: productize an opt-in flag for customers to preview the pricing model.

Ryan (Product): Proposed quick sketch:

```
PriorityRoute Add-on (beta):
- Reserved tier: $300/month per reserved-QPS (includes 500k tokens/day)
- Overage: $0.0006 / token above included
- Migration: 3 months 50% credit for existing customers
- SLA: p99 < 180ms for hosted; dedicated SLA negotiable
```

Jonah (Sales): Can we have tiered reserved-QPS (1,5,20) so field can sell smaller commitments? Also need churn protection in the first 6 months.

Tess (Finance): Tiering ok. We'll require a 12-month minimum commitment for the 5 & 20 QPS tiers. Floor pricing for renewals + 10% list price increase option.

Amy (Legal): Add clause: customers on private deployments must opt into PriorityRoute and accept limited cross-region guarantees. Need privacy/data residency checkbox.

Sana (Customer Success): Launch criteria suggestion: migration tooling ready, one reference customer migrated, and billing UI visible in console with clear estimated impact.

EngBot (deploy-bot): Noted: adding telemetry events: prio_route.request, prio_route.hit, prio_route.latency.

Ryan (Product): Action items: Jonah to run a top-20 leads screening for interest; Tess to draft floor/minimums; Amy to prepare T&C addendum; Eng to estimate infra delta and telemetry; Sana to pick pilot customer. Sync on Friday 10am. :thumbsup:
